seatRail.label: Seeds
seatRail.switchWhileGeneratingBody: Switching seats aborts and discards the running response. Switch anyway?
seatRail.reauth: Sign in again to load your Seeds
seatRail.createHelp: A Seed is its own workspace. It is free and uses your Account credit pool.
seatRail.createNameRequired: Enter a name for the Seed.
seatRail.timeoutRetry: The request timed out. Reconcile again — no second Seed will be created.
seatRail.createError: The Seed could not be created.

authority.notConfirmedYet: This setting came from an older version and you never confirmed it. Have a look.
authority.ladderDescription: One rung. It governs the everyday decisions — not the delicate ones below.
authority.sealsTitle: What EVE may only do with explicit permission
authority.sealsDescription: These five hang off no rung. Even on “Full” they stay off until you switch each one on.
authority.budgetMissing: Without an amount the money seal stays shut. Money commands EVE recognises as such do not get through.
authority.budgetHigh: That is a high daily amount. It is saved — please check you did not mistype.
authority.budgetNotEnforced: The amount is saved, but this version does not yet enforce it as a daily ledger. EVE therefore still asks separately for recognised money commands. If you enable autonomous Browser/Desktop control, this amount does not technically constrain its clicks. The configured limit is not a blank cheque.
authority.opaqueUiDescription: Hermes remains available at all times. Here you decide only whether EVE may execute the visible final step without a separate prompt.
authority.opaqueUiToggleTitle: Run clicks and input without asking
authority.opaqueUiToggleBody: Applies to known browser clicks, typing, key presses, dialog confirmation, CDP and non-reading screen control. EVE still asks separately for new unknown tools.
authority.opaqueUiRungRequired: Available from “Independent”. On a lower rung, a previously granted permission stays recorded but inactive.
authority.opaqueUiWarning: Broad permission: a click may indirectly pay, publish, delete, reveal credentials or change production. The five effect seals and recorded daily amount do not yet technically constrain such Browser/Desktop steps.

watch.title: Watch only
watch.body: EVE reads, thinks along and suggests. It changes nothing, not even what you granted.

ask.title: Ask me
ask.body: EVE asks before every change. You see each step before it happens.

routine.title: Routine
routine.body: EVE reads and writes inside your workspace. For commands it asks.

work.title: Working
work.body: Plus routine commands: tests, builds, read-only git.

independent.title: Independent
independent.body: Plus everything reversible, including outside the workspace.

full.title: Full
full.body: Plus irreversible work. The five below still stay off.

money.title: Spend money
money.body: Paid models and services. You name the amount you record for it when you switch this on.

publish.title: Publish and send
publish.body: Emails, posts, anything that reaches other people.

delete.title: Delete outside the workspace
delete.body: Touch files that do not belong to the project.

credentials.title: Read credentials
credentials.body: See secrets and keys in clear text.

authority.fullReleaseDescription: For a machine that is yours and where EVE should simply get on with it. Sets the rung to “Full”, opens the five effect seals and lets you confirm Browser/Desktop autonomy separately.
authority.fullReleaseActive: Full release is active. Rung “Full”, all five effect seals open, Browser/Desktop autonomy confirmed, recorded upper bound {{amount}}. You can withdraw any single item above at any time.
authority.fullReleaseConfirmIntro: Here is what happens when you confirm:
authority.fullReleaseMoneyLabel: Release spending — an amount is required
authority.fullReleaseOpaqueUiBody: This broad permission is independent from the five effect seals and is never inherited from an old setting.
authority.fullReleaseMoneyLimit: Spend money: opens, with {{amount}} as the recorded upper bound.
authority.fullReleaseMoneyUntouched: Spend money: stays as it is — the full release does not touch this one.
authority.fullReleaseOpaqueUiEnables: Browser & Desktop: clicks and input may run without separate prompts.
authority.fullReleaseOpaqueUiDisables: Browser & Desktop: the broad permission is withdrawn; EVE asks again before clicks and input.
authority.fullReleaseOpaqueUiAlreadyOpen: Browser & Desktop: the broad permission is already active.
authority.fullReleaseOpaqueUiUntouched: Browser & Desktop: stays as it is — without this separate confirmation, nothing new is allowed.
authority.fullReleaseBudgetMissing: Spend money: without an amount, money stays closed. Name a number, or switch this item off.
authority.fullReleaseNothingToDo: Nothing would change — all of this is already set that way.
authority.limitsDescription: Your rung governs Hermes tools — terminal, files, browser, screen control, memory, skills, processes and schedules. These technical boundaries remain separate.
authority.limitScreen: Screen control: visibility and navigation follow your rung. Clicking and typing always remain available. Without the broad Browser/Desktop permission, you approve the final step separately; with it, EVE runs the known UI actions autonomously. Hermes still blocks a few destructive system key combinations so the running machine cannot be locked or logged out.
authority.limitScanner: Command scanner: the extra security scanner lets things through when it is not running or not installed. It is a second opinion, not a lock.
authority.limitMemory: Memory, skills and schedules: changes now follow your rung. On Full, EVE may maintain them independently; lower rungs use the normal approval card.
authority.limitWebsites: Website blocklist: if it is misconfigured it counts as empty, and everything is reachable.
authority.limitTimeout: Unanswered requests: a permission card you leave unanswered for five minutes counts as denied — not as granted.
authority.limitMoney: Daily amount: the amount is saved, but is not yet booked against daily usage. Recognised money commands still require a separate approval. Enabled Browser/Desktop autonomy may complete payments through the UI without this amount technically constraining them.
authority.rememberedDescription: Commands you allowed permanently for this seat. EVE stops asking for them — until you withdraw one here.
authority.rememberedEmpty: Nothing remembered yet. EVE asks for every command.
authority.pageDescription: Decide what EVE may do without asking — and withdraw anything it has remembered, any time.
